disambiguation: Not a free-form agent loop; it uses a deterministic, orchestrator-led pipeline with strict validation before any vault modification.
extras: Desktop only. No git repository required for the undo net.
intentEvidence: Run autonomous local LLM agent teams ("crews") on your Obsidian vault, powered by a local LLM model (LM Studio or Ollama) — with a deterministic, orchestrator-led pipeline and a snapshot safety net under every run.
problem: It addresses the risks and unpredictability of using LLMs for vault automation by enforcing a deterministic, constrained execution pipeline.

relations.evidence: powered by a local LLM model (LM Studio or Ollama)
powered by a local LLM model (LM Studio or Ollama)

summary: Vault Crews runs autonomous local LLM agent teams using a deterministic pipeline to process and modify vault content based on defined tasks.
